mapper.select: SELECT emp17_benefit_id AS benefit_id , f_emp_kor_nm(emp17_person_id) AS person_name , emp17_issue_amt AS issue_amt , emp17_occ_date AS occ_date , emp17_benefit_detail AS benefit_detail , emp17_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_title AS appr_title_name , CAST(apr01_reg_date AS date) AS appr_reg_date , apr01_inout_cd AS appr_inout_code FROM emp17_benefit LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON emp17_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE emp17_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp17_benefit_id IN #{id}
